metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the Solaris the smfproperty test is properly supported.
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evalutate to true if the interpreter properly supports the solaris smfproperty test.

criterion.comment: Test that the solaris smfproperty test is supported with service, instance, and property operations of 'equals'.
Test that the solaris smfproperty test is supported with service, instance, and property operations of 'pattern match'.
Test that the solaris smfproperty test is supported with service operation of 'not equal', and instance and property operations of 'equals'.

smfproperty_test.comment: Test that the smfproperty test is supported with service, instance, and property operations of 'equals'.
Test that the smfproperty test is supported with service, instance, and property operations of 'pattern match'.
Test that the smfproperty test is supported with service operation of 'not equal', and instance and property operations of 'equals'.

smfproperty_object.comment: Retrieve the service: /network/smtp, instance: sendmail and property: config/local_only with operation of 'equals'.
Retrieve the service: /network/smtp, instance: sendmail and property: config/local_only with operation of 'pattern match'.
Retrieve the services 'not equal' to 'network/smtp' and filter include only serivce '/network/loopback:default'.

smfproperty_state.comment: Confirm correct service, property, and and value collected.
Confirm correct service, property, and value collected.
